name: OCTA Teen Council
what_you_do: Learn about OCTA projects on topics like land use, planning and funding. You share ideas that shape OCTA programs. You also go to workshops and volunteer at community events.
who_can_apply: High school students. The program page does not list other rules, so ask OCTA.
pay_detail: The program page does not mention pay.
duration: School year. Six Tuesday meetings, Aug 25, 2026 to April 27, 2027, 5:30 to 7:00 p.m.
deadline_text: The program page says applications open every spring. Exact 2027 dates are not posted as of Nov 2, 2026.
how_to_apply: Check the program page in the spring for the application. Questions: teencouncil@octa.net.
notes: Meetings are at OCTA Headquarters, 550 S. Main Street, Orange. Dates can change. Last spring's exact dates are not shown on the program page.
